subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff & next steps
body:
--- Message 1 of 5 ---
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@axiomhealth.com>, Tom Riley <tom.riley@axiomhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC kickoff & next steps

Hi Elena / Tom,

Great to meet you both on the call today — thanks for walking through the use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Scope: Evaluate Redwood inference for care notes summarization (real-time summarization of clinician notes at shift end). We agreed to focus the POC on the inpatient notes dataset and two models (redwood-tiny and redwood-small) to compare latency & quality.
- Success criteria: <20% loss in F1 vs current baseline for extractive cues, median 99th-percentile latency < 350ms for 1-2 concurrent requests, and infra setup by your IT team completed.
- POC duration: 2 weeks (target kickoff Mon, 9 Mar)
- Action items (owner / due):
  - Axiom IT: open firewall & allow outbound to our VPC endpoints (see attached Network_Firewall_Instructions.docx) — due Fri, 6 Mar (Tom)
  - Axiom data owner: share 100 sample notes in secured S3 location or via secure upload link — due Fri, 6 Mar (Elena)
  - Redwood (me): provision kickoff tenant, send onboarding checklist and invite to kickoff call — done (attached POC_onboarding_checklist.pdf)

I'll provision the POC tenant and send the kickoff calendar invite once we confirm the network access and sample data. If the Fri timeline is tight, we can push kickoff to the following week — let me know.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0187

[Attachment: POC_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]
[Attachment: Network_Firewall_Instructions.docx (docx, 12KB)]

Hi Elena / Tom —

Bumping this thread since I haven't seen the sample data or confirmation on IP ranges. Goal is to avoid a half-staffed kickoff — if the IT/ops work isn't possible this week, we can reschedule kickoff to Mon 16 Mar.

Cc'ing Marissa (CS lead) and Vivek (my manager) who can help unblock on the technical side and coordinate priority. If helpful, Marissa can run a short white-glove onboarding session with your IT to walk through the steps — that usually clears most blockers in 30-45 mins.

Can you confirm by EOD whether we should hold for 16 Mar or cancel and reconvene next week?

Best,

Elena / Tom —

Last try for the week — I know priorities shift and teams get busy. If the POC is no longer a current priority, happy to pause and re-engage later; if it is still on, Marissa can help set up a quick call with your IT to complete the network steps.

Two options:
1) We hold kickoff Mon 16 Mar as planned — confirm and we'll send calendar invite and infra details today.
2) Pause POC — we'll archive current tenant and reopen when you're ready.

If neither is accurate, please reply with timing and I'll accommodate. If I don't hear back by next Tue, I'll mark the deal as paused in our tracking and follow up in two weeks.

Thanks — Rafael
